backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor implementing a contact form submission system with admin-only viewing (with filtering/sorting), user profile management, and role-based access control via MixinAuthorization.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping completed feature IDs (primarily Hindi translations of UI components) to their affected files, related components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON document containing one-line summaries of all frontend source files, describing their purpose and Hindi translation status for the Kattar Sanatani Yodha application.
frontend/index.css: Base CSS file setting up Tailwind directives and defining CSS custom properties for light and dark theme color tokens using OKLCH values.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the React app with Google Search Console verification meta tag, root div, and module script reference.
frontend/public/ads.txt: Google AdSense ads.txt file declaring a direct relationship with publisher ID pub-4905807488237044.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that configures TanStack Router with eight routes (Home, About, Programs, Philosophy, Resources, Contact, Donate, Admin) under a shared Layout.
frontend/src/components/Footer.tsx: Footer component with all text in Hindi, including quick links, contact details (email, phone, location), and social media icons for Facebook, X, WhatsApp, and YouTube.
frontend/src/components/Hero.tsx: Hero section component with a background image, Sanskrit tagline, Hindi mission statement, and two CTA buttons (support mission and learn more) in Hindi.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Layout wrapper component that renders Navigation and Footer around page content via TanStack Router's Outlet.
frontend/src/components/Mission.tsx: Renders a 'Our Sacred Mission' section displaying four core values (Bhakti, Raksha, Gyan, Ekta) as icon cards with Hindi text in a responsive grid layout.
frontend/src/components/Navigation.tsx: Sticky navigation bar with logo, Hindi nav links, responsive mobile menu, and a conditional admin link shown only to authenticated admin users.
frontend/src/components/ProgramCard.tsx: Reusable card component that displays a program with a Lucide icon, title, and description in a styled hover-animated card.
frontend/src/components/SupportOptions.t: Displays four support options (volunteer time, spread awareness, contribute skills, share knowledge) as cards with icons and links to the contact page.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Custom hook that creates and caches an ICP backend actor using React Query, handling both anonymous and authenticated (Internet Identity) access, and invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useContactForm.ts: Custom hook managing contact form submission state (submitting, success, error) by calling the backend actor's submitContactForm method.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides an Internet Identity authentication context and hook, managing AuthClient creation, login/logout flow, identity persistence, and delegation validity checks.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching all contact submissions, checking if the caller is an admin, and retrieving the current user's profile from the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet importing Google Fonts and defining a Sanatani-inspired warm (saffron/terracotta) color palette via CSS custom properties for both light and dark modes, plus utility classes for patterns and gradients.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app wrapped with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider.
frontend/src/pages/About.tsx: Renders the About page for KATTAR SANATANI YODHA, displaying a hero section, organization story, and a grid of four core principles (mission, vision, values, community) in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Admin.tsx: Admin dashboard page that requires Internet Identity authentication and admin role, displaying a searchable, filterable table of contact form submissions with CSV export functionality.
frontend/src/pages/Contact.tsx: Contact page with a Hindi-language form (name, email, message) that submits via useContactForm hook, alongside contact info and social media links.
frontend/src/pages/Donate.tsx: Donation/support page showing support options via SupportOptions component, impact area breakdowns with progress bars, and a transparency commitment section, all in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Home page composing Hero and Mission components with a 'What We Do' highlights grid and a call-to-action section linking to donate and contact pages, in Hindi.
frontend/src/pages/Philosophy.tsx: Philosophy page presenting Sanatana Dharma teachings in Hindi, covering its eternal nature, unwavering devotion (Bhakti Yoga), and exemplary devotees like Ram, Hanuman, and Yudhishthira.
frontend/src/pages/Programs.tsx: Displays a Programs page with a hero section, a grid of six program cards (Vedic study, cultural festivals, youth education, community gatherings, social welfare, heritage preservation) in Hindi, and an impact statistics section.
frontend/src/pages/Resources.tsx: Renders a Resources page with a hero section and a grid of four resource categories (sacred texts, video lectures, articles, downloadable materials) with Hindi content and item lists.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utility functions for reading, storing, and clearing URL parameters from both regular query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the default theme with custom OKLCH colors (saffron, gold, etc.), custom fonts (Inter, Cormorant Garamond, Cinzel), warm box shadows, and accordion/fade-in animations.
project_state.json: Tracks project state at version 9, documenting a Hindi translation initiative for the entire app, listing completed feature translations per component/page and noting a known issue where deployed translations are not taking effect.
